description: Per-platform linear understeer (L_eff, K_us, b) plus a steering-rate phase-lead term (tau). Tesla passes V0 through.
notes: Tesla truth channel psi_dot_rads is the V0 KS output, so Tesla is intentionally passed through unchanged.
Coefficients fitted with scipy.optimize L-BFGS-B on a route-grouped 80/20 train/dev split, objective=yaw_plus_cte (cte_weight=2.0).
